# malloc

Stock heap allocator, class 1 pool.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60024068` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Allocates from the class 1 pool at 0xa2852000 to 0xa285d280. Pair with free at 0x6002409a.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): Used by the camera-proven card probe in the OM-3 developer notes. Source: [Caduceus OM-3 developer notes](../sources/om3.devnotes.md).
- **Emulator** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Runs as stock in the lab as the allocator for the uncached pools. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
